subject: Vendor onboarding: ClearPath Logistics — PO routing & payment terms
content:
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@clearpathlogistics.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Liz Reynolds <liz@clearpathlogistics.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: ClearPath Logistics — PO routing & payment terms

Hi Michael / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick welcome last week. Attached are our completed vendor onboarding form and a current W-9 for ClearPath Logistics. A few items we want to confirm up front so we can align our billing:

- Standard payment terms requested: Net 30 (we typically onboard new partners on Net 30).
- We can offer a 1.5% early-pay discount if invoices are paid within 15 days.
- PO routing: would Redwood prefer one consolidated monthly PO or per-shipment POs?
- Invoice delivery: is AP@redwood.com the correct remit-to or should invoices go to finance-invoices@redwood.com?

Also attaching a sample invoice template if that helps.

Liz and I are hoping to close onboarding this month — can you share the expected timeline and any missing artifacts?

Thanks,
Sam Turner
Vendor Relations
ClearPath Logistics
Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf; W9_ClearPath_2026.pdf

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@clearpathlogistics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 11:40:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: ClearPath Logistics — PO routing & payment terms

Sam — thanks for the form and W-9, appreciate the clarity. Quick answers and next steps: 

- Payment terms: Redwood’s standard for newly onboarded logistics/ops vendors is Net 45 while we complete an initial operational integration. Our AP policy allows exceptions but they require Finance sign-off.
- Early-pay: we do evaluate early-pay discounts as part of an "accelerated remit" program. Finance will need details (discount %, typical monthly volume, and ACH details) to assess economics.
- PO routing: procurement prefers per-shipment POs for easier reconciliation, but we can support consolidated monthly POs for high-volume partners if the invoice line items map cleanly to our PO lines. If you want consolidated POs, please attach a consolidation flow (how you aggregate shipments into an invoice).
- Remit-to: please send invoices to finance-invoices@redwood.com and cc AP@clearpathlogistics.com on your side. We also require the Redwood PO number on invoice line items for automatic matching.

I've attached our standard PO template for your invoices and a link to our vendor portal — please register there so we can push the vendor record into our ERP: https://redwood.example.com/vendor-portal/register?company=ClearPath

Action items from our side: procurement (Marissa) will confirm PO routing constraints; Finance (Kimberly) will review early-pay enrollment. Can you provide a simple monthly volume estimate and your ACH remittance instructions?

Best,
Michael Grant
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: PO_template.xlsx

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Turner <sam.turner@clearpathlogistics.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:05:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: ClearPath Logistics — PO routing & payment terms

Hi team — looping in Finance details. Sam, great to meet you via email. A few items about our early-pay/accelerated remit program: 

- Baseline: new vendors default to Net 45 while we run through a 60–90 day operational validation window. Standard cadence is monthly payment runs (cutoff 5th business day).
- Early-pay options: we can offer Net 30 in exchange for either a fixed discount (we typically see 0.75%–1.5%) or a processing fee depending on volume and margin impact. For logistics vendors we usually aim for 1.0% for Net 30 with monthly volume above $50k; lower volumes may be evaluated case-by-case.
- Required docs to evaluate early-pay: completed earlypay_enrollment_form.pdf, ACH remittance letter, current W-9 (received), and a sample 2–3 months of invoice volume.
- Operational requirements: invoices must include Redwood PO number, SKU/line-item mapping, and a remittance email (finance-invoices@redwood.com). We use a 3-way match for on-time payment (PO, invoice, and delivery confirmation).

If ClearPath is open to Net 45 for the first 90 days and then move to Net 30 after a successful run, that would be the fastest path to activation. Otherwise we can fast-track an early-pay evaluation if you submit the enrollment form and the monthly volume data today.

I'll attach the enrollment form and our internal checklist.

Kimberly Park
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: earlypay_enrollment_form.pdf

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Sam Turner <sam.turner@clearpathlogistics.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Liz Reynolds <liz@clearpathlogistics.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:20:07 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: ClearPath Logistics — PO routing & payment terms

Thanks Michael and Kimberly — that all makes sense. A couple of notes from our side: 

- We can accept Net 45 for an initial 90-day onboarding window. After 90 days we’d prefer to move to Net 30 if still aligned on volume.
- Consolidated PO option: we can provide a monthly consolidated invoice as long as each invoice includes a per-shipment breakdown (shipment IDs, dates, and amounts) so you can apply PO line matching. I’ve attached a short flow diagram that shows how we roll shipments up into a consolidated invoice.
- Volume: typical monthly billing for our Redwood account would be ~ $72,000 (seasonal variation +/- 20%).
- ACH: we will email our ACH remittance letter and banking details via secure portal (listed in the onboarding form).

Can we target vendor record activation and first PO issuance the week of July 6? Let me know anything else you need to take the vendor live.

Appreciate the quick coordination — Sam
Sam Turner
Vendor Relations
ClearPath Logistics
Attachments: consolidation_flow.pdf

------------------------------------------------------------
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Turner <sam.turner@clearpathlogistics.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 16:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: ClearPath Logistics — PO routing & payment terms

All — quick summary and mutual action plan so we have one place to track items: 

1) Vendor registration: Sam to complete vendor portal registration and upload ACH letter (link below). Target: 2026-07-02.
   - Link: https://redwood.example.com/vendor-portal/register?company=ClearPath
2) Documents received: onboarding form (received), W-9 (received).
3) Early-pay evaluation: Sam to submit earlypay_enrollment_form.pdf and 2 months of invoice history by 2026-07-02; Finance (Kimberly) to review by 2026-07-06.
4) PO routing: procurement prefers per-shipment POs. ClearPath to confirm ability to include per-shipment breakdowns on consolidated invoices (Sam has provided flow). Procurement (Michael) will accept consolidated monthly PO only if per-shipment line mapping is present. Decision: tentative by 2026-07-06.
5) First PO & activation: contingent on portal registration and outstanding docs. Target first PO week of 2026-07-06.

If anyone needs me to raise a vendor onboarding ticket in our ERP, I can do that today and assign to David for vendor code creation.

Thanks — will follow up once the enrollment form is in.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf; W9_ClearPath_2026.pdf; PO_template.xlsx; earlypay_enrollment_form.pdf; consolidation_flow.pdf
